Fit non-dub-region translated text around its original source bbox.

        - Only applies to text ABOVE the dubbing region (non-dub text with source_bbox).
        - Text is positioned at the center of the original source_bbox from Gemini.
        - Horizontal text starts with a 3.0× bbox width limit.
        - Vertical source text keeps one complete translated word per line.
        - A normal word stays intact unless it is wider than the safe screen area.
        - If the wrapped text's height exceeds 3.0× bbox height, the font size is scaled down.
        - Text bottom must not cross dub_top (top of dubbing region).
        - Dub-region text is returned unchanged (subtitles display normally).

        Returns (x, y, est_width, est_height).

BƯỚC 4: Xác nhận thay thế các đoạn đã chọn - THAY THẾ VÀO ĐOẠN BẢN DỊCH BỊ LỖI
            Thay thế đúng vị trí trong bản dịch hiện tại bằng bản dịch mới đã được dịch lại từ bản gốc

Worker thread để dịch lại - QUY TRÌNH ĐƠN GIẢN HÓA:
            1. Hiển thị ngữ cảnh của cả đoạn lỗi đã dịch (tiếng Việt) - để xem ngữ cảnh
            2. Dịch trực tiếp đoạn lỗi trong bản dịch (có chữ Trung còn sót) - KHÔNG CẦN lấy từ bản gốc
            3. Thay thế vào đoạn bản dịch bị lỗi (sẽ thay thế trong confirm_replace)

Chia danh sách phụ đề thành num_parts phần đều nhau.
        Mỗi phần trả về dict:
          {
            'part_no': int,           # 1-based
            'subs': [SubtitleEntry],  # danh sách subtitle objects
            'original_indices': [int] # index gốc của từng sub trong phần này
          }

Collapse a transient OCR variant into its adjacent stable caption.
Collapse stable OCR variants before they become separate translations.
Delete only exact, pipeline-owned subtitle and audio intermediates after success.

Disentangle simultaneous dual-dialogue tracks from wrapped lines.

        If an entry contains distinct speaker dialogue (e.g. marked turns or independent
        Q&A utterances), split into parallel lane entries with appropriate geometry.
        For separate overlapping entries, assign dialogue lanes so downstream filters,
        ASS collision handling, and TTS parallel mixing preserve their independent timing.
Drop malformed boxes and OCR items below their confidence threshold.

Enable output folder controls only when saving translated copies.

Export each tracked utterance once; SRT supports overlapping cues.

        Slicing A[0,4] + B[1,3] into A / A+B / A made TTS repeat A three times.
        Keep the original intervals and spatial identity, even for equal words.
Export the edited/translated entries verbatim; merging is an explicit edit.

Extend confirmed tracking asynchronously, always using unmodified source.

        Prefetch small overlapping windows, and hold playback if a needed window
        is still pending. Neither subtitle blur pixels nor its protected ROI are
        inputs to the tracker. Workers exchange plain data with the Tk thread.

Plan a shared local tempo with bounded drift; concurrent voices keep their own slots.

        All units are 48 kHz samples. The plan is computed before processing audio,
        so spare time in a following cue can help a long preceding phrase. Captions
        themselves are never mutated. Unavoidable dense speech is reported, not cut.

Repair at export/TTS boundaries, including old ASS checkpoints.

        ASS quantizes to centiseconds. Never allow rounding or overlap trimming

        discarding real words just to make the timeline non-overlapping.
Repair cue boundaries without treating punctuation in subtitle text as separators.
